name: Studious Librarian
summary: Studious librarians are bards that have studied long in great libraries of the Inner Sea region.
replacesText: Distraction; Suggestion; Jack-of-All-Trades; Dirge of Doom; Mass Suggestion; Deadly Performance

features.name: Scribe Scroll
features.summary: At 6th level, a studious librarian gains Scribe Scroll as a bonus feat. This ability replaces distraction.

features.name: Comparative Arcane Studies (Su)
features.summary: At 6th level, the studious librarian is exposed to a wide variety of magical writing, and can use his own magic to duplicate spells from other classes’ spell lists. Once per day, a studious librarian can cast any spell from the bard , sorcerer/wizard , or witch spell lists from a scroll or spellbook in hand as if it were one of his bard spells known, expending a bard spell slot of the same spell level to cast the desired spell. Casting a spell from a scroll this way does not cause the spell to vanish from the scroll. A spell cast in this way cannot be modified by metamagic. The studious librarian gains one additional daily use of this ability at 10th level and again every 4 bard levels thereafter, to a maximum of four times per day at 18th level. This ability replaces suggestion and jack-of-all-trades.

modes.label: Bard
modes.summary: Cast a Bard-list spell from the held writing.

modes.label: Sorcerer/Wizard
modes.summary: Cast a Sorcerer/Wizard-list spell from the held writing.

modes.summary: Cast a Witch-list spell from the held writing.

activeEffect.name: Comparative Arcane Studies casting
activeEffect.description: Cast the selected written spell as a Bard spell known. A scroll used this way is not erased.

resourceActions.summary: Spend a daily use and the matching Bard slot while preserving the source scroll.

features.name: Critical Research Focus (Ex)
features.summary: At 8th level, the studious librarian threatens a critical hit on a Research check ( Ultimate Intrigue 148 ) with a roll of 18, 19, or 20. He gains a +4 bonus on Research checks to confirm a critical hit. This ability replaces dirge of doom.

resourceActions.label: Roll a Research check
resourceActions.summary: The roll exposes the expanded natural 18–20 threat range and +4 confirmation bonus.

features.name: Perfect Recollection (Ex)
features.summary: At 19th level, the studious librarian can always take 20 on Knowledge checks. This ability replaces mass suggestion.

resourceActions.label: Take 20 on a Knowledge check
resourceActions.summary: Resolve any Knowledge check with a fixed d20 result of 20.

features.name: One with the Library (Ex)
features.summary: At 20th level, the studious librarian can replace one of her spells known with any bard spell from a scroll once per day by studying the scroll for 1 hour. Doing so erases the spell from the scroll. This ability replaces deadly performance.

activeEffect.name: One with the Library
activeEffect.description: Replace one Bard spell known with the chosen Bard spell from the studied scroll.

resourceActions.summary: Spend the daily use after 1 hour of study and update the known spell selection.

mechanicalNotes: Scribe Scroll, all four Comparative Arcane Studies uses, Research critical rules, unlimited Knowledge take 20, and the daily scroll-based known-spell replacement are automated.
